turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Iyer?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Ananya from the City Care Clinic in Hyderabad. I am calling about your cardiology reports.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, the reports. Are they ready? I was waiting for the call.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, they are ready for pickup. While you are coming, can we confirm your follow-up appointment for Tuesday at ten?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Tuesday... let me check my diary. Yes, I think ten is fine.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Perfect, I have booked that for you. Please bring the previous files along with you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Will there be any payment for the reports today?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The total for the scans and consultation is twelve thousand rupees, but you can just settle it at the billing counter when you visit.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twelve thousand? That is a bit more than I thought.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It includes the advanced imaging, Mrs. Iyer. You can pay by card or cash at the clinic.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, I understand. I will come on Tuesday then.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you. We will see you then. Have a good day.
